scenario: Synthetic document API; architectural judgments, not production policy

cards.callers: One deterministic n8n workflow knows the document ID
cards.model_boundary: No model receives the document in this fixed path
cards.consent_and_authorization: Service identity and document ACL would be required in production
cards.rationale: A stable one-caller lookup already has a precise HTTP contract; MCP adds no needed discovery here.

cards.callers: Two independent AI hosts need a bounded policy search
cards.model_boundary: Only authorized, minimized snippets may enter a model context
cards.consent_and_authorization: Server must filter by user and tenant before returning snippets
cards.rationale: A narrow discoverable search contract could be reused by separate hosts, if filtering and data minimization are enforced.

cards.model_boundary: No autonomous model call is permitted for this write path
cards.consent_and_authorization: Lab has no real identity, object authorization, or approval evidence
cards.rationale: A write-capable tool would be unsafe without verified identity, object permission, explicit consent, and audit evidence.
